title: Three Rounds
logline: A student from Addis Ababa learns that the coffee ceremony he left behind was never about the coffee: it was about not carrying things alone.

style.style_block: Warm hand-painted gouache illustration, visible brush texture, soft paper grain, gentle natural light, cinematic composition with the main subject centred in the frame

characters.robel: a young Ethiopian man in his mid-twenties with short black curly hair and warm brown skin, wearing a plain olive-green hoodie
characters.jebena: a traditional Ethiopian jebena: a round-bellied black clay coffee pot with a long narrow neck, a short spout and a handle joining the neck to the body

narrator.style: warm, calm and unhurried, a young man remembering

mother.style: warm and gentle, like a mother comforting her son

music.caption: slow warm instrumental underscore, Ethiopian krar and soft piano with gentle strings, intimate and nostalgic, sparse texture that leaves room for a narrator

cues.feel: warm, gently rising; introduces the theme
sparse and cold, almost silent piano
the theme returns, fuller and warm

shots.reason: Establishes the place and states the film's theme in its first line.
shots.keyframe_prompt: Addis Ababa at dawn seen from a hillside, eucalyptus trees in the foreground, low houses with tin roofs, mountains in the distance, thin smoke rising from homes, warm amber morning light
shots.motion_prompt: slow push-in, light mist drifting, smoke rising gently

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In Addis Ababa, nobody drinks coffee alone.
lines.subtitle: In Addis Ababa, nobody drinks coffee alone.

shots.reason: Introduces the motif through smell and ritual; my mother is present only as her hands.
shots.keyframe_prompt: close-up of a woman's hands, the sleeves of a white cotton dress with an embroidered border, roasting green coffee beans in a flat iron pan over a small charcoal stove, fragrant smoke curling up, warm amber light
shots.motion_prompt: hands gently shake the pan, smoke curls upward, static camera

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: My mother roasts the beans, and the smoke calls the neighbors in.
lines.subtitle: My mother roasts the beans, and the smoke calls the neighbors in.

shots.reason: Shows what I will lose, the circle and the conversation, and names the three rounds that structure the film.
shots.keyframe_prompt: the young man sits laughing with family and neighbors around a low table with small handleless coffee cups and the jebena, fresh grass scattered on the floor, the others seen from behind or softly out of focus, warm amber light
shots.motion_prompt: people lean in and laugh, steam rises from the cups, slow gentle pan

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Three rounds: abol, tona, baraka. And between them, we talk about everything.
lines.subtitle: Three rounds: abol, tona, baraka. And between them, we talk about everything.

shots.reason: The decision to leave: I carry home with me, but not what matters most.
shots.keyframe_prompt: an open suitcase on a bed with folded clothes, a small cloth bag of coffee beans and the jebena tucked between them, warm amber evening light from a window
shots.motion_prompt: very slow push-in, a curtain moves slightly

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: When I left to study abroad, I packed the coffee. Not the people.
lines.subtitle: When I left to study abroad, I packed the coffee. Not the people.

shots.reason: Contrast with Addis: the same coffee in my hand, and no one to share it with.
shots.keyframe_prompt: a university campus in late autumn, students walking fast with headphones, bare trees, the young man standing alone in the middle holding a paper coffee cup, cool blue-grey overcast light, muted colours
shots.motion_prompt: students stream past while the young man stays still, static camera

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Here, people are kind. But everyone is in a hurry.
lines.subtitle: Here, people are kind. But everyone is in a hurry.

shots.reason: The low point: stress carried alone, the opposite of the coffee circle.
shots.keyframe_prompt: the young man at a small desk late at night, laptop light on his tired face, textbooks and papers piled up, a dark window behind him, cool blue-grey light
shots.motion_prompt: he rubs his eyes and leans back, slow push-in

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: When it got hard, I carried it alone. Like an adult, I thought.
lines.subtitle: When it got hard, I carried it alone. Like an adult, I thought.

shots.reason: The turn: my mother's proverb names what I was missing.
shots.keyframe_prompt: the young man holding a phone to his ear in a dark room, the screen glow on his face, cool blue light with a small warm glow from the phone
shots.motion_prompt: he closes his eyes and listens, static camera

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At midnight, I called home. My mother said:
lines.subtitle: At midnight, I called home. My mother said:

lines.speaker: mother
lines.subtitle: "The medicine for a person is a person."

shots.reason: The motif returns: I rebuild the ritual myself, and the colour starts to warm.
shots.keyframe_prompt: the young man's hands roasting green coffee beans in a small pan on an electric stove in a narrow dorm kitchen, smoke rising, the jebena waiting on the counter, light turning warm and golden
shots.motion_prompt: hands shake the pan, smoke curls upward, slow push-in

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So I found green beans, and roasted them in a tiny dorm kitchen.
lines.subtitle: So I found green beans, and roasted them in a tiny dorm kitchen.

shots.reason: Baraka, the blessing: the circle rebuilt with new people, echoing the first line.
shots.keyframe_prompt: the young man pouring coffee from the jebena into small cups for four classmates from different countries sitting on the floor of a small apartment, talking and laughing, warm golden lamp light
shots.motion_prompt: he pours slowly, friends lean in and laugh, slow orbit

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: My friends come from five countries. Now none of us drinks coffee alone.
lines.subtitle: My friends come from five countries. Now none of us drinks coffee alone.

shots.reason: The resolution, and the one thing I want viewers to do.
shots.keyframe_prompt: close-up of the young man smiling, holding a small coffee cup with both hands, friends softly out of focus behind him, warm golden light
shots.motion_prompt: he looks up and smiles, steam rises, very slow push-in

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: If you're leaving home, pack the coffee. Then find your people.
lines.subtitle: If you're leaving home, pack the coffee. Then find your people.
